title: Hamiltonian Graph Mechanics for Constrained Granular Media Flow: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Granular particle flow involves discontinuous contact mechanics that break standard continuous neural dynamics. We embed unilateral non-penetration constraints directly into graph Lagrangian neural networks using dual cone projections. In pebble-bed reactor simulations, our model preserves momentum conservation to within 1.2e-6 over 50,000 timesteps. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 2.8x and a verified task accuracy of 99.2% with mean execution latency of 8.1ms.
